HK1-B.prompt:
Shot on an iPhone 17 Pro Max, handheld, the main camera at 24mm equivalent, everything left on automatic. An ordinary photo taken on an ordinary phone.

AN EXTREME CLOSE-UP OF A 74-YEAR-OLD WOMAN'S RIGHT KNEE WEARING THE STRAP as she steps down the carpeted staircase at home. The phone is held low, close in front of her knee, by someone a couple of stairs below her. The knee and the strap fill the frame, from just above the kneecap to the top of the shin, the knee slightly bent as she steps down. The hem of her teal skirt just shows at the top edge. Behind, soft and out of focus: worn beige stair carpet, a brass stair rod, a magnolia wall. The same woman as in the first attached image, the same hall and stairs as in the second attached image.

The strap is worn exactly as in the last attached image: on the right leg ON THE PATELLAR TENDON, directly BELOW the kneecap, centred on the FRONT of the knee and square to the camera. The concave notch at the centre of the shell's top edge cups the kneecap's lower border with no gap; two matching peaks of equal height rise either side, no higher than the base of the kneecap's sides; the kneecap's face stays bare above. The shell spans the whole front of the joint and ends in a brushed chrome slide at EACH outer side of the leg, the black coarse-knit band running round behind the knee. The grey stryde wordmark is horizontal and readable, centred directly beneath the notch. The strap itself exactly as in the two attached product photos: a rigid matte-black shell, about as tall as the kneecap, the band about half the shell's height, snug and flat on the skin.

Real unretouched skin of about seventy: age spots, fine creases, fine hairs, visible pores, the band pressing a shallow dent into the flesh above and below it.

Light: soft morning daylight from the front-door glass below, the wall behind a stop darker, soft sensor noise.
